title: Q4 sales planning
text:
Maya: We need to improve the Q4 sales forecast. The team discussed using a new dashboard, but we have not chosen a vendor.
Rahul: I will prepare the Q4 sales report by Friday.
Maya: We agreed to review the forecast every Monday.
Jon: Can we include the renewal pipeline too? We do not have the latest numbers yet.
Maya: Yes, let's follow up on the renewal data next week.

title: Product launch readiness
text:
Aisha: The team discussed a June launch, but support coverage is still uncertain.
Leo: We decided to launch the beta on June 12, subject to the security review.
Aisha: Leo, can you confirm the support rota by Wednesday?
Leo: Yes, I will share the rota by Wednesday.
Mina: Is the onboarding email ready?
Aisha: I will draft the onboarding email tomorrow. We should revisit launch readiness after security signs off.

title: Marketing budget review
text:
Chris: We discussed moving spend from search into events, but no decision was made today.
Priya: I will compare the event and search channel costs by Tuesday.
Chris: We agreed to keep the current budget unchanged until we see that comparison.
Sam: What is our target cost per lead for the next campaign?
Priya: That is still open. Let's follow up after the cost review.

title: Service incident retrospective
text:
Nora: The database alert fired late during Friday's incident.
Evan: We agreed to lower the alert threshold from 85% to 75%.
Nora: Evan will update the alert configuration by Thursday.
Evan: I will also add the recovery steps to the runbook by Friday.
Tess: Do we know whether the delayed alert was caused by the new deploy?
Nora: Not yet. We will investigate the deploy timeline and revisit the alert routing next week.

title: Design hiring sync
text:
Drew: We discussed adding a take-home exercise to the design interview, but the panel was split.
Mei: I will draft two interview-loop options by Monday.
Drew: We decided to keep the current interview process for this hiring round.
Mei: Should we include a portfolio review for senior candidates?
Drew: Let's follow up after we compare the two options.
